name: SVC_NOTIFY_CFG_EVT_RCPTS
description: This table is used to store the definition of which recipients receive configured notifications.

columns.name: CFG_EVT_RECIPIENT_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CFG_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the SVC_NOTIFY_CFG_EVENTS table.

columns.name: CFG_OBJ_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: This is the internal attribute name of the recipient

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_CD
columns.description: The unique object code value obtained from appcomposer api

columns.name: ACCESSOR_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Internal attribute name of the accessor for the recipient object

columns.name: RECIPIENT_TEXT_VALUE
columns.description: Contains recipient value for recipient types that support it.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_ID_VALUE
columns.description: Contains the identifier value for recipient types that support it.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_GROUP_CD
columns.description: Specifies the recipient group defined in ORA_SVC_NTF_RECIPIENT_GROUPS lookup type.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The recipient type code used to indicate of which type is the definition.  This is taken from a lookup code with values ('ORA_VO_ATTRIBUTE', 'ORA_PARTY_ID', 'ORA_TEAM_ID')

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies if the recipient is enabled

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
